entries.gap: The aggregate firearm-homicide measure records no personal exposure or victimization.
entries.estimate: Route a changed place rate to resident safety-context estimates; preserve the rate's firearm-share and territory proxy limitations. Do not produce injuries or deaths.
entries.estimatedFrom: CDC National Center for Health Statistics 2024 age-adjusted homicide mortality rates and CDC FastStats 2024 national firearm share (15,364 of 20,162 homicides), as calibrated in crime.firearm-homicide. Each place rate is an estimate using that national firearm share; the five territory rates retain the sourced Florida or Hawaii proxies recorded in the place measure. This is an estimate of a resident's safety context. It assigns no individual firearm exposure, injury, homicide, or personal victimization.

entries.gap: Government borrowing records no individual tax incidence, private debt, bondholding, or service reduction.
entries.estimate: Use resident fiscal-context estimates alongside the existing public-budget consumer; create no personal bill, payment, loan, or public-service cut.
entries.estimatedFrom: SEC Investor.gov, General Obligation Bond (https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/glossary/general-obligation-bond), and GFOA, Adopting Financial Policies (https://www.gfoa.org/materials/adopting-financial-policies). Public debt service is a resident fiscal-context estimate because general-obligation borrowing is backed by the issuer's taxing power. It does not establish a personal tax bill, public-service cut, private borrowing rate, bondholding, or household debt change. The place measure retains its sourced credit-rating spread estimates and five territory average proxies. Calibration: S&P general-obligation ratings for 2024 (Wikipedia, List of U.S. states by credit rating, from S&P Global; D.C. from its current S&P rating; Montana from Moody's Aa1, as S&P does not rate it), priced at 6 basis points per notch below AAA through A+ (Joffe, Doubly Bound: The Cost of Issuing Municipal Bonds, Haas Institute 2017, from Bloomberg five-year index yields), and 12 per notch below A+, where the same source says spreads steepen (the 12 is this game's reading, not the source's number); ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE for Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands: 8.7 basis points, the arithmetic mean of the recorded 2024 values for all 50 states and D.C. A AAA state starts at 0 and may drift a little below it, as top-rated bonds sometimes trade through the benchmark.

entries.gap: Individual irrigated parcels, wells, water rights, and pumping allocations are unrecorded.
entries.estimate: Use current recorded agricultural operators as an estimated irrigation-resource cohort; record no personal pumping, permission, crop, or income change.
entries.estimatedFrom: USGS 2015 irrigation groundwater withdrawals and USDA NASS 2023 Irrigation and Water Management Survey (https://www.nass.usda.gov/Surveys/Guide_to_NASS_Surveys/Farm_and_Ranch_Irrigation/). Current recorded agricultural owners or directing operators in their home state supply an estimated irrigation-resource context. Their existing work cohort is inferred exposure; it does not establish an irrigated parcel, well, water right, pumping allocation, personal withdrawal, crop yield, or income change. Lower pumping is estimated groundwater conservation, not a measured operator benefit. ESTIMATED FROM MEDIAN for American Samoa, Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands: 102.4 million gallons a day, the median of the 53 recorded USGS 2015 irrigation groundwater withdrawal values, including recorded zeros for D.C. and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Source: USGS Estimated Use of Water in the United States, County-Level Data for 2015, version 2.0, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7TB15V5. Those three territories are absent from this calibration.
